# Dolphin AI

A little videogame for GitHub Game Off gamejam. The theme is waves.
Made with Godot with only purpose of learning and have fun

For some assets we use AI and resources from others, here the list of tools, models and authors

* Code generated with VSC, GitHub copilot with Claude Haiku 4.5 model
* Images generated with Nano Banana. Transparency removed with InSPyReNet and adapted with GIMP
* Music generated by [suno](https://suno.com/)
* InkScape for the background
* Dynamic Water https://youtu.be/RXIRkou021U?si=qh6oanThST76m8US
* Learn godot (in spanish) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eQ_HBvtdoiU
* Sounds recorded at home
* jump into water splash sound.wav by NIkhill Kumar -- https://freesound.org/s/320330/ -- License: Creative Commons 0
* Dolphin.wav by Forpus_Prod -- https://freesound.org/s/391317/ -- License: Creative Commons 0
* sharkIsNear.ogg by kradziej -- https://freesound.org/s/511281/ -- License: Creative Commons 0

Huge thanks to everyone who made the tools, resources, and tutorials that helped me build this videogame!

## How to play

<https://jesusnoseq.itch.io/dolphin>

### Touch/Mobile

#### Player 1 (Left Half of Screen)

* Tap **top-left** → Swim up
* Tap **bottom-left** → Swim down

#### Player 2 (Right Half of Screen)

* Tap **top-right** → Swim up
* Tap **bottom-right** → Swim down

### Keyboard

#### Player 1

* **W key** → Swim up
* **S key** → Swim down

### Player 2

* **UP Arrow** → Swim up
* **DOWN Arrow** → Swim down

## Gamepad/Joystick

* **Left Analog Stick Up/Down** → Swim up/down

## Game Mechanics

* Dolphins automatically swim **forward**
* **Tap/press** to control **vertical movement** (jump up or dive down)
* **Jump out of water** to avoid obstacles and get a speed boost
* **Collect fish** to get a speed boost
* **Avoid sharks and boats**
